findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_excellent_pages · Private data: search_excellent_pages, find_event_venues, send_event_inquiry · Public sink: send_event_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_excellent_pages · Private data: search_excellent_pages, find_event_venues, send_event_inquiry · Public sink: send_event_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
